title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Federal Policy Fee on a Cancellation Refund
content:
Fee schedule entry for the Federal Policy Fee when a policy under the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) is cancelled and refunded.

**Earned and returned.** For a cancellation refund whose current term and the term before it together carry at most one premium-bearing endorsement and at most one re-rate credit, each counted by its risk premium entries, and only for such a refund, the Federal Policy Fee of a term that began after the cancellation took effect is returned in full, while that of the term in which a cancellation under current term full or pro rata takes effect stays fully earned; for a cancellation refund whose terms carry more than one premium-bearing endorsement or more than one re-rate credit, the Federal Policy Fee is fully earned under current term full and pro rata.

**Rule.** The Federal Policy Fee a cancellation refund returns is settled as follows: when the reason refunds from inception, the Federal Policy Fees of the current term and the term before it; when the cancellation took effect before the current term start, the current term's Federal Policy Fee in full; otherwise none.

A reason refunds from inception when it is a duplicate NFIP policy or a loan closing that did not occur.

## Schedule

| Reason / effective date | Federal Policy Fee returned |
|---|---|
| duplicate NFIP policy or closing did not occur | current and preceding terms' fees |
| any other reason, effective before the current term start | the current term's fee in full |
| any other reason, effective on or after the current term start | none |

## Cases (hypothetical fees)

- Closing did not occur; fees of 47.00 for the current term and 45.00 for the preceding one: 92.00.
- Building sold with a title transfer date before the current term start; current fee 47.00: 47.00.
- Mortgage paid off, effective mid-term: none.
